newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul raises tax incentive to replace facilities.
newsitem.headline: Seoul raises tax incentive to replace facilities.

text.p: South Korea's Finance and Economy Ministry said on Tuesday it would offer additional tax incentives to replace old facilities.
A ministry statement said the government would raise the tax benefit to 10 percent of the total investment from the current five percent.
But the tax benefit will be applied only for investments through the end of this year.
The statement said the government wanted to revitalise Korean companies hit by the current economic slowdown and sharpen the country's international competitiveness.
The ministry plans to implement the new rule in May after a consultation with cabinet members.
